_comment: Paths are for the build machine. DBs: tw = Turtle world (Tortoise), ac = PRISTINE acore_world (without this module applied).

ids._comment: Reserved ranges. Each zone gets slot*10000 GUIDs inside the creature/gameobject range. Taxi nodes must stay below 448 (client TaxiMask). dungeon_access_template.id is a TINYINT: the module uses 250-255, then 249 downwards. Turtle items whose id 3.3.5 uses for a different item get item_remap_base + their Turtle id. Turtle reputations whose id 3.3.5 uses for another faction get faction_base+ ids, new faction templates faction_template_base+, new reputations reputation indexes from reputation_index_base (client limit 128).
ids._comment_client: Client-table and server *_dbc ids the module allocates. Never 'stock max + 1': HD patches and other modules (mod-individual-progression) add their rows right after the stock ids, and a full-table patch then hides one side. Measured stock/HD maxima: LoadingScreens 300, MapDifficulty 754+, WorldMapArea 922, WorldMapOverlay 1641, Light 2546, LightParams 926, WMOAreaTable 51118.

area_id_remap._comment: Turtle area ids that 3.3.5 uses for another area (Turtle reused Northrend ids). They get these ids in the client tiles, AreaTable, quests, WMO areas and world-map overlays. Never change one once shipped.

global_excludes._comment: Turtle-only systems that do not exist on AzerothCore.

creature_id_takeover._comment: 3.3.5 test templates nothing spawns or uses, whose ids Turtle gave to real creatures: the zone that spawns them writes Turtle's template over them and its rollback puts the stock rows back. The 3.3.5 name is checked at build time.

creature_id_remap._comment: Turtle creatures whose id 3.3.5 uses for a creature it spawns (so the id cannot be taken over): they get the id creature_remap_base + their Turtle id in every row the module writes (template, spawns, quests, scripts, texts). The value is the 3.3.5 name, checked at build time. Elder Moonhoof (Moonwhisper Coast) / Shoveltusk Forager; Lovely Pink Fox (Gilneas City) / Battlemage Vyara.

lock_substitutions._comment: Turtle locks that need a Turtle key item (no 3.3.5 Lock.dbc row can ask for it) -> a plain 3.3.5 lock; the zone's manual script makes the loot need the key.

_faction_keep_335: Turtle factions whose 3.3.5 row stays as it is (Battleground Neutral 709: Turtle gives it a hidden reputation; the Scarlet camp in Tirisfal uses its template 1194, which 3.3.5 has too).

spell_substitutions._comment: Turtle spells that do not exist in 3.3.5, or whose id is a different spell there -> 3.3.5 stand-in (0 = drop).

mount_spell_by_item._comment: Turtle mount items (all use Turtle's generic mount spell 46499) -> the closest 3.3.5 mount spell; the item then teaches it like a stock mount item.

go_model_substitutions._comment: Turtle object models that a 3.3.5 client does not have -> an existing 3.3.5 display id (number) or a 3.3.5 model path (text).

m2_substitutions._comment: Turtle-made doodad models (1.12 format, unreadable by 3.3.5) -> a 3.3.5 model with a similar look. Paths inside map tiles and buildings are rewritten.

zone_music_substitutions._comment: Turtle ZoneMusic ids that mean something else (or nothing) in 3.3.5 -> 3.3.5 ZoneMusic id (2 = Duskwood, 1 = Elwynn Forest). 563 (Turtle Windhorn Canyon; 3.3.5's 563 is Pit of Saron) -> 9 Plains (Thousand Needles). Moonwhisper Coast's own music (Turtle 570 Moonwhisper, 571 Moonwhisper Tauren, 572 Tyrandas, 510 WC3 Night Elf, 514 Indule; in 3.3.5 these ids are Zul'Farrak event and Ulduar music) -> 191 Dark Forest (Darkshore), 9 Plains, 11 Enchanted Forest (Ashenvale).

intro_music_substitutions._comment: Turtle ZoneIntroMusicTable ids with no 3.3.5 equivalent.

quest_npc_substitutions._comment: quest -> {Turtle quest NPC: 3.3.5 stand-in} for quest givers / turn-ins that exist in 3.3.5 but are never spawned there

client335_skip_archives._comment: Archives of the 3.3.5 client (HD patches) whose map tiles are not used as the base of merged tiles: the merge starts from the standard 3.3.5 tile, and the module's patch-y wins over these anyway.

_client335: Extract of the server owner's PLAY client (client335_extract.py). The build takes every client table and file it changes from the highest-priority archive there (build.py archive_rank), so the patch keeps the HD/other patches' rows. A different client (e.g. the Backup Client without patch-x) gives a patch that hides the play client's own changes.

tile_fixes._comment: Applied to every shipped tile at the end of the build (Max's fixes, 2026-10-09). remove_placements: tile -> unique ids of placements to drop (3.3.5's Stormwind Harbor hangar blocks Turtle's Northwind gate). texture_substitutions: Turtle terrain textures that render flat neon green in the 3.3.5 client -> stock texture. dark_water_below: Turtle water keeps its 'deep' flag (server dark water, Fatigue) only over ground lower than this.

seabed_from_turtle_server._comment: Sea chunks more than deeper_than yards below Turtle's server height (TWoW Data maps, where Turtle has water over it) take Turtle's server heights; edges meet the unchanged chunks; MH2O depth = depth_per_yard x yards.

_never_ship: Turtle files with the names of stock 3.3.5 files that must not replace them (the Stormwind harbor dock textures), the Turtle textures tile_fixes replaces, and buildings (WMO roots; their groups go with them) Turtle copied from TBC/Wrath that the 3.3.5 client already has at the same path (found in AzerothCore's vmaps with the same group count): the client's own files are used.

reserved_client_ids._comment: client-table ids the module must not use: Max's own rows in his patch-z (WorldMapOverlay: 3 Arathi rows, 3085-3087 earlier, now 3111-3113).

ground_effects._comment: Max's fixes 2026-10-09 (handoff section 4). rows: GroundEffectTexture rows written into the client's own table (weights all 1). copy = doodads and terrain type of a stock row; doodads = GroundEffectDoodad ids; neither = Turtle's own doodads matched to 3.3.5 models by name. 30004/30008 are not in Max's list (unverified guess: Turtle's doodads, density 10). retag: untagged layers of a texture get a row, only in new-zone chunks of those zones. no_clutter: noEffectDoodad on cells under water (surface more than water_above over the ground) or whose most visible texture is a road or sand, new-zone chunks only.
